description: Find the capability for a need described in plain words, English or Chinese, among 383 on 41 platforms: up to 5, best first, each with what it needs, its price and a ready call. With a platform and no match it lists everything that platform has; never use another platform's capability in its place. Free, no key.

limit.description: How many matches, 5 when left out.

platform.description: A platform ID or name (douyin, xiaohongshu, wechat_mp, bilibili, weibo, tiktok, x, youtube, meta, google, instagram, reddit, kuaishou, zhihu, wechat_channels, wechat, facebook, linkedin, threads, telegram, pinterest, amazon, aliexpress, taobao, alibaba_1688, xianyu, jd, douyin_shop, toutiao, xigua, baidu, bluesky, app_store, twitch, douban, imdb, youku, lemon8, xiaoyuzhou, apple_podcasts, all). Alone, it lists everything the platform has.

query.description: What is needed, in words, e.g. "小红书笔记评论" or "comments under a TikTok video".

name: find
title: Find a capability
